name: Production error to shipped fix
description: Reproduce a new production error, fix it with a regression test, have a second operator review it, then stop and ask a person before anything merges or deploys.

steps.title: Reproduce the error
steps.instruction: Reproduce the error described in the signal. Report the smallest reproduction, the likely cause and the affected code path.

steps.title: Write the fix and a regression test
steps.instruction: Using the reproduction above, add a failing regression test, then the smallest fix that makes it pass. Open a pull request.

steps.title: Review the diff in a fresh session
steps.instruction: Review the pull request from the previous step as an independent reviewer. List concrete findings, or state that there are none.

steps.title: Merge and deploy
steps.question: Merge this fix and deploy it to production?

steps.title: Watch the rollout
steps.instruction: Watch the deploy of the merged fix. Compare the error rate and latency before and after, and report the numbers.
